papers.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading
papers.authors: Giannouris, Jiang, Qian, Wang, Peng, Huang, Xiong, Ananiadou
papers.summary: Two-level hierarchy: LLM selects pairs via semantic reasoning (long horizon), RL executes spread trades (short horizon). Prompt-based policy updates instead of gradient fine-tuning. No specific Sharpe reported but 'consistent improvements over cointegration baselines'.

papers.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers.summary: Multi-modal framework combining 15 fundamental metrics, 3 technical indicators, and FinBERT sentiment. Transformer architecture achieves best macro-F1 for earnings-day direction prediction. Ablation confirms consistent benefit from news sentiment.

papers.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers.summary: 138k+ earnings press releases (2005-2023). FinBERT embeddings + topic analysis. Soft information (text) as informative as EPS surprise. Online learning for real-time prediction. Previously staged as H293 on 2026-06-13.
papers.note: Already staged as H293 on 2026-06-13 — do not duplicate

papers.title: The Self Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
papers.authors: Andrew Ang, Nazym Azimbayev, Andrey Kim
papers.summary: 50+ specialized agents compete across 20+ portfolio construction methods. Meta-agent learns from past forecast accuracy. Governance via IPS document. Diversity-maximizing ensemble (vs. adversarial debate in TradingAgents). No performance metrics reported.

papers.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
papers.authors: Xia, You, Wang, Liu, Qi, Wu, Zhang
papers.summary: Systematic review of 77 LLM trading agent studies. Key finding: only 2/19 report extractable protocols, 1/19 includes transaction costs, 0/19 achieves full reproducibility. Architecture expanding but evaluation protocols are the bottleneck.

papers.title: QuantEvolve: Automating Quantitative Strategy Discovery through Multi-Agent Evolutionary Framework
papers.summary: Quality-diversity optimization + hypothesis-driven multi-agent system for systematic strategy space exploration. Claims outperform conventional baselines. No specific metrics disclosed.
papers.note: Interesting for dream cycle itself but no specific H-number connection without performance metrics

papers.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization with Bias Correction
papers.summary: Systematic risk factor identification + bias correction to remove unintended systematic exposures in cross-sectional portfolios. Directly addresses the H313 finding (sector-neutral didn't reduce market exposure because bias correction was implicit not explicit).
papers.note: Good reference for factor-models.md wiki update in next cycle

papers.title: LLMs for Time Series: An Application for Single Stocks and Statistical Arbitrage
papers.summary: LLMs applied to time series forecasting for single stocks and stat arb. Foundational work.
papers.note: Superseded by Moira (2605.01954) which is more specific to pairs trading

github_findings.summary: Skewness-Enhanced and Dual Momentum (TSM+CSM) across S&P 500 and STOXX 600. Dual momentum showed superior performance in European market.
github_findings.note: H313 is the S&P 500 variant — already tested. European universe could be interesting for H319.

github_findings.summary: Curated list of quant finance libraries, packages, and resources. Long-standing reference.
github_findings.note: Already known resource, no new action needed
